comparison.interpretation: No overall semantic-classification improvement or deterioration on these eight short clips. One already-major collision case now additionally changes collision to invitation; another word (car) is repaired. The two acceptable English cases remain acceptable. Greek normalized word edits remain 18/73; English falls from 7/45 to 5/45 largely because you are now matches the reference instead of you’re. Numeric words/digits and Manta/μάντα are equivalent despite literal edit flags.
comparison.limitations: The replay uses a different QA virtual-environment path with matching recorded core versions and the same weights, but not a full package-lock or machine-state identity check. Production app/cache-lifecycle source has also changed since the old run. Elapsed values include model loading and exports and are not a controlled VAD-only speed benchmark. These clips contain short read speech; they cannot validate long-film completeness, exact silence rejection, noisy speech or default Auto detection.

pipeline_assessment.timing_note: All eight outputs are single cues. VAD-off changes their start/end boundaries, including starts at zero; the harness accepts a limited duration tolerance. No independently annotated timing reference is present, so finite ordered bounds do not approve word alignment.

decision: The VAD-off change preserves the real upload/storage/export workflow on these exposed native clips, while existing Small-model semantic limits remain. Use these outputs as editable drafts with review of names, content words, numbers and negation. This regression does not by itself establish a global accuracy guarantee or validate exact-zero audio behavior.
